title: Cache Diagnostics
description: Deep cache diagnostics for the LOCAL cache test stack. LOCAL synthetic test traffic only, combined across every LOCAL acceptance run in the selected window (not one acceptance run, not production). Every counter is rated per series before summing; current-value series are kept only while their own scrape target reports up == 1. Absent data means unknown or not exercised, never a healthy zero.

panels.title: Refresh queue residence p95
panels.description: Time jobs wait in the queue. LOCAL synthetic test traffic only, combined across every LOCAL acceptance run in the selected window (not one acceptance run, not production). Every counter is rated per series before summing; current-value series are kept only while their own scrape target reports up == 1. Absent data means unknown or not exercised, never a healthy zero.

defaults.noValue: No data: unknown / not exercised / no live target — never a healthy zero

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(skipper_custom_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",key="cache.reval_wait_duration"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)))
